review.notes: All 17 physical pages screened by column-aware PDF-text line diff plus a full structure scan (fence balance: 0 printed markers, heading/figure/table inventory); deep verification concentrated on the flagged spots: p.1 affiliation footnote (420 dpi), p.2 Figure 2 card labels/prompts (100 dpi full page), p.3 Figure 4 sentence split and contributions lead-in (100/260 dpi), p.5 benchmark footnote (340 dpi). Tables 1-4 and 6-8 were compared structurally (rows present as HTML tables); their cell values were NOT verified value-by-value, and display equations were not re-derived against the print; these remain under unresolved. The remaining unmatched PDF lines are table bodies, reference wrap continuations, figure-internal text and the print's own misspellings ("Textcaps", "crodsourcing", "envets" on p.13 are present in the PDF text layer and were preserved as printed).
